worst_three.problem: The whole Microsoft agents story runs well over 150 words with no pause, so a phone listener loses the identity and audit point.
worst_three.fix: Insert [Pause] after 'the agent picks up the comment.', after 'without anyone asking it to.' and after 'the tech team can shut it down.'; split the sign-in sentence: 'Its sign-in and every action are logged under its name. So there's a clear audit trail. And the tech team can shut it down.'

worst_three.problem: Broad-audience listeners hear 'tokens' and 'parameters' with no idea what they are, so the price war and the Qwen numbers mean nothing.
worst_three.fix: After 'Pricing is per million tokens.' add 'A token is roughly a short word or part of a word.' Before '2.4 trillion parameters' add 'Parameters are the internal settings a model learns; more usually means more capable.'

worst_three.problem: Listeners don't know what HUMAIN, Hugging Face or Space42/Exodigo are, so they can't follow who is doing what.
worst_three.fix: Rewrite as 'HUMAIN, Saudi Arabia's national AI company backed by the Public Investment Fund, is targeting...'; 'the Hugging Face platform, a popular site where developers share AI models'; 'Space42, a UAE space-tech company, and Exodigo, which maps underground sites without digging, have partnered...'
